name: maktaba
description: Maktaba – The Digital Library. Responsive web, Expo mobile app and REST API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @maktaba/shared && npm run build -w @maktaba/api && npm run build -w @maktaba/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @maktaba/api && npm run test -w @maktaba/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @maktaba/api && npm run typecheck -w @maktaba/web && npm run typecheck -w @maktaba/shared
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
